title: Black Whale exterior refinement
purpose: Replace the placeholder hull cage with a recognizably whale-like, evidence-bounded exterior production envelope while preserving noncanonical scale, unknown surfaces and all topology restrictions.

authorizedClaims: The main exterior is deliberately whale-shaped.
The upper Tier 1 vessel is visually distinct from the lower whale hull.
The five-tier inhabited structure fits within the broad exterior envelope.
Exterior views authorize silhouette study but not engineering dimensions.
quarantinedClaims: Exact length, beam, draft, curvature and waterline.
Exact mouth, eye, fin, stern, propulsion, opening or support geometry.
Exact material, panel, window or mechanical detailing.

refinementTargets.permission: Refine a broad blunt head-side silhouette and brow transition.
Refine continuous upper-back and lower-belly curves across the working hull.
Create a smoother narrowing rear continuation needed for a coherent whale silhouette.
prohibitions: No exact tail or propulsion design

refinementTargets.permission: Blend the upper vessel footprint into the back region while retaining it as a distinct mass.
prohibitions: No invented deck or window grid

refinementTargets.permission: Improve shading, waterline context and certainty readability.

roadmapBoundary: Phase 7.3R may refine exterior macro form only. It may not start Phase 7.5 routes or Phase 7.6 room production.
